incidentRuling.factsAccepted: drafting agent accidentally opened one sealed holdout-inputs.json, halted immediately, excluded content; Main verified zero payload-derived content in spec (independently re-verified above).
incidentRuling.ruling: COHORT STANDS SEALED-QUALIFIABLE WITH CONDITIONS: (1) the incident is terminal for the AGENT, not the cohort — the drafting agent is barred from all future G3/G4 sealed work (accounting, labeling, re-derivation, adjudication of disputes) and from any Batch3/Batch4 sealed-file access; identity + bar recorded in the stage record; (2) the affected cohort file keeps its sealed standing ONLY because no derived content entered any artifact and no labels/counts-by-class/floor inputs exist — any evidence to the contrary (including agent memory reuse in later sealed steps) voids the cohort; (3) G3 accounting and G4 labeling MUST be executed by agents with no prior sealed-payload exposure, attested on the record before each gate; (4) the incident file path + timestamp + agent identity + halt attestation MUST be appended to the stage record before G3. Rationale: qualification turns on independence of labels from premature exposure; a halted, excluded, content-free accidental open by an agent who is then permanently removed from the sealed path preserves label independence. A second incident, or any use of incident-derived knowledge, voids the affected cohort permanently with no cure.
